Everything’s the same. I get taken advantage of. It’s the same customers everyday. The same mundane tasks that fill me with no sense of accomplishments. The same anxiety about being blamed for every little stupid thing.

It didn’t feel like it was worth going on anymore. I struggled to complete the simplest of actions. It took all my energy to get a shower or to brush my teeth. I didn’t want to continue in a world that was so cruel.

Of course the thought snowballed that I’d have to take the rubbish to Tip and the attendants would judge me. This is how anxiety makes my mind work. There’s no shame if you feel similar and suffer distress over everyday things. You aren’t alone #MentalHealthMatters

I just feel like hibernating. I feel really anxious and insecure at the moment and I don’t really know why.

I make lists or take photos of things I take on holiday. Why? Because I’m terrified that I’ll leave something behind and it’ll be forgotten about. I project my own feelings of abandonment onto material possessions.

I dread going into work and have to build myself up to going in. Why? Because I’m terrified that someone will come to me and tell me I’m crap and that there is no longer a job for me. I fear that even if they say I’m good it’s all just a joke.

I spend a lot of time sleeping. Why? Because I try to think about others. I dread thinking that I pushed someone to a dark place. I'll settle for less and drain myself for others. I'll sleep to shut down & create a whole world that is my own - if it hurts me I make it disappear.
